body.name: Parametric cylindrical-algebraic atlas procedure
body.construction: For rational or real-algebraic observed summaries and endpoints of \(\mathcal B\), \(\mathsf{ATLAS}\) treats \((\Gamma_A,\Gamma_0,\Gamma_1)\in\mathcal B\) as parameters, eliminates the legal mixture-root and stationary variables, and performs parametric cylindrical algebraic decomposition over \(K_{\mathrm{in}}\) to return exact quantifier-free sign cells and algebraic optimizer strata.  Rational isolating intervals are returned only after a zero-dimensional specialization.
